title: Classes suspended in Pagudpud due to Typhoon Rosal

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Classes at all levels in public and private schools in Pagudpud, Ilocos Norte, were suspended on Friday due to Typhoon Rosal. Classes in other areas will proceed as scheduled unless separate suspension announcements are issued. In its 5 a.m. bulletin, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said Rosal maintained its strength while moving northwestward over the sea east-northeast of Batanes.
